svg.title: A published caution appears only as attributed text
svg.desc: Keep the published caution as attributed text with byline and date. No portrait, body or invented setting may give the named speaker a dramatized scene.

No portrait, body or invented setting may give the named speaker a dramatized scene.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "location-background-documentary-evidence-field", "box": [ 0.02, 0.02, 0.96, 0.96 ], "color": "steel" }, { "asset": "monitor", "box": [ 0.2148, 0.1282, 0.5336, 0.3968 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "PUBLISHED CAUTION", "label_box": [ 0.20679999999999998, 0.531, 0.5496, 0.085 ] } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "hero", "source": "
**Location:** `documentary-evidence-field`

**Frame:** A named investigator's published caution, set as text on a screen with its byline
and date visible, in the register the critic's window uses. No face, no body, no room.

**Screen / system text — PUBLISHED, ATTRIBUTED (PARAPHRASED):**
`SOME OF THE INCENTIVES ON A THIRD-PARTY INVESTIGATOR PUSH TOWARD MAXIMIZING THE APPEARANCE
OF ASSURANCE WITHOUT PROVIDING MEANINGFUL OVERSIGHT.`

**Action:** The strongest warning about the investigation comes from inside it.

**Provenance:** `documented` — attributed paraphrase of Beth Barnes' dated public writing,
registered in [`sources.md`](../../research/sources.md). She is describing the position of a
third-party investigator, not this book, and the page may not extend it to anyone she did
not name.

", "title": "A published caution appears only as attributed text" } }
